entries.source: January 15, 2013
Please read this first:
entries.ko: 먼저 다음 안내를 읽으시오.

entries.source: 1. The time available for the theoretical competition is 4 hours. There are three questions.
entries.ko: 1. 이론시험의 제한 시간은 4시간이며, 문제는 세 문항이다.

entries.source: 2. Use only the pen provided.
entries.ko: 2. 제공된 펜만 사용하시오.

entries.source: 3. You can use your own calculator for numerical calculations. If you don’t have one, please ask for it from Olympiad organizers.
entries.ko: 3. 수치 계산에는 자신의 계산기를 사용할 수 있다. 계산기가 없으면 대회 운영진에게 요청하시오.

entries.source: 4. You are provided with Writing sheet and additional paper. You can use the additional paper for drafts of your solutions but these papers will not be checked. Your final solutions which will be evaluated should be on the Writing sheets . Please use as little text as possible. You should mostly use equations, numbers, figures and plots.
entries.ko: 4. 답안지와 여분의 종이가 제공된다. 여분의 종이는 풀이를 연습하는 데 사용할 수 있으나 채점하지 않는다. 채점받을 최종 풀이는 답안지에 작성하라. 설명은 가능한 한 간결하게 쓰고, 주로 수식·숫자·그림·그래프를 사용하라.

entries.source: 5. Use only the front side of Writing sheets . Write only inside the boxed area.
entries.ko: 5. 답안지는 앞면만 사용하고 테두리 안에 작성하라.

entries.source: 6. Begin each question on a separate sheet of paper.
entries.ko: 6. 각 문제는 새 답안지에서 시작하라.

entries.source: 7. Fill the boxes at the top of each sheet of paper with your country ( Country), your student code ( Student Code ), the question number ( Question Number) , the progressive number of each sheet (Page Number ), and the total number of Writing sheets used ( Total Number of Pages ). If you use some blank Writing sheets for notes that you do not wish to be evaluated, put a large X across the entire sheet and do not include it in your numbering.
entries.ko: 7. 각 종이 위쪽 칸에 국가(Country), 참가자 번호(Student Code), 문제 번호(Question Number), 답안지의 쪽 번호(Page Number), 사용한 답안지 총 쪽 수(Total Number of Pages)를 기입하라. 채점을 원하지 않는 메모용 답안지에는 종이 전체에 큰 X를 긋고 쪽 수에 포함하지 마시오.

entries.source: 8. At the end of the exam, arrange all sheets for each problem in the following order:
entries.ko: 8. 시험이 끝나면 문제별로 다음 순서에 따라 종이를 정리하시오.

entries.source: [[0]] Used Writing sheets in order; [[1]] The sheets you do not wish to be evaluated [[2]] Unused sheets and the printed question. Place the papers inside the envelope and leave everything on your desk. You are not allowed to take any paper out of the room.
entries.ko: [[0]] 사용한 답안지를 쪽 순서대로 정리한다. [[1]] 채점받지 않을 종이를 놓는다. [[2]] 사용하지 않은 종이와 인쇄된 문제지를 놓는다. 모든 종이를 봉투에 넣고 책상 위에 두시오. 어떤 종이도 시험실 밖으로 가져갈 수 없다.

entries.source: Problem 1.A Pulley (5,0 points) The rope of length [[0]] and mass [[1]] is put on the pulley of radius [[2]] . The rope begins to slide off the pulley without friction. Consider the time moment when the difference in height between the hanging ends of the rope is equal half of the rope length. For this time moment find the following: 1. acceleration of the rope; 2. the tension of the rope at the top of the pulley; 3. the point of the rope at which the tension is maximum (it is enough to find the angle between the radius to that point and the vertical).

entries.source: Problem 1.B Assistant Vapor (2.0 points) In the physical laboratory the thermometer reading was 20 ºC, and the barometer reading was 1 atm. The laboratory assistant Vapor pulled out a sturdy vessel of the closet, poured some water into it and sealed it with the lid. Then assistant Vapor slowly heated the vessel to the temperature 200 ºC. At this temperature, the pressure in the vessel turned out to be 2,88 atm. Find the temperature at which all the water evaporated. Justify your answer.
entries.ko: 문제 1B 조교 베이퍼 (2.0점) 실험실 온도계는 20 °C, 기압계는 1 atm을 가리킨다. 조교 베이퍼는 튼튼한 용기를 꺼내 물을 조금 붓고 뚜껑으로 밀봉했다. 용기를 천천히 200 °C까지 가열하자 압력이 2.88 atm이 되었다. 물이 모두 증발한 온도를 구하고 근거를 설명하라.
